primary_risk: Unauthorized access to cloud credentials could lead to unauthorized access across multiple cloud environments.
likely_attack_path: Compromised Lambda function with excessive permissions -> Access Secrets Manager -> Retrieve cloud credentials
security_signals: Access key usage outside normal patterns
Changes in Secrets Manager access policies
investigation_goals: Identify unauthorized access to cloud credentials
Trace the source of the unauthorized access
hidden_truth_candidates: IAM roles with overly permissive policies
